items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: Interviewee mentions Robichaux as a professional violin player and 'best man of the actor' but does not claim personal interaction, collaboration, or membership in a group with him. The interviewer asks 'Did you know any of the men with Robichaux?' implying the interviewee did not know Robichaux dir

ctx.x: And the songs. He used to, he has a lot of it, Robichaux music and making copies of it. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah, Robichaux used to come. Robichaux was our best man of the actor. He's a professional. Oh, he's a violin player.
